task: RD036-A: 20cm Deep-Open High-Order Synergy (Cold50 x CLEAN_B x Mech130 x 3-Way/4-Way/Shallow-Tree)
exact_mtm_methodology: True daily close-to-close bar MTM aligned to WF trading dates (mtm_reconciliation_diff < 1e-6; zero geometric return smoothing).

executive_findings.1_mtm_sharpe_truth: True bar-MTM Sharpe of BASE_V11_S82 is 1.737 (MDD 30.27%), vs geometrically smoothed 2.329 in W2A3 and date-index-shifted 1.336 in W2A4.
executive_findings.2_cold_plateau: Disabling F06 on cold days (mkt10 < cut) forms a monotonic plateau from cut<40..55 across Pure Cold, CLEAN_B, and Mech130; Cold50/55 consistently lifts WF NAV and 2526 NAV.
executive_findings.3_mech130_d20_plateau: Cold50 + MechNat130 peaks at d5 (89.18x, Sh=2.272) and d10 (86.85x, Sh=2.232, Comb 2.83x), holds at d15 (70.33x), and collapses at d20 (38.28x, Sh=1.923) due to over-writing V20 score.
executive_findings.4_two_secondary_fusion_winner: Half-weight blend (Cold50 + round(0.5*CLEAN_B_d15 + 0.5*Mech130_d15)) at S80 achieves 146.36x WF NAV (Ex5 32.47x, Sharpe 2.413, WR 59.26%, 2526 14.59x, 26H2 2.28x, 80bps 74.24x, paired t=2.970 vs S82, DSR=1.0000/0.9751, V20 Comb 1,743,104.54x = 2.8495x).
executive_findings.5_3way_and_trees: 3-Way AND + Depth=3 GBDT discover clean orthogonal alpha (2B_TREE_D3 achieves lowest ML family CSCV PBO=27.38%, GBDT_D3_cold50_d8_S80=107.88x / Sh=2.284). 3-Way average stack (Stack_c50_Avg_CB15_MN15_R3W12_S80) cuts MDD to 26.08% with 61.24% WR, 125.96x WF NAV, 75.44x >=2yi NAV, and 2.5068x V20 Comb.
executive_findings.6_4way_vs_3way_verdict: 4-Way expansion & Depth=4 trees over-fragment sample size: DT/GBDT depth=4 doubles PBO (27.38% -> 55.56%) and drops GBDT_cold50_d8_S80 NAV from 107.88x to 60.49x (-44%). Rule4Way adds negligible value over CLEAN_B+3Way.
executive_findings.7_global_cscv_warning: Global CSCV PBO across all 548 tested variants is 79.37% (med OOS rank 27.46%) because blind argmax over 548 noisy configurations picks low-sample S84 / depth-4 spikes; disciplined fixed-budget families (2B_TREE_D3 PBO=27.38%, 1B_CLEANB_COLD50 PBO=32.14%) remain robust.
